summary: D.C. and Virginia are currently fighting Trump administration plans for a 250-foot arch, with hundreds rallying to protect Hains Point, while the District navigates political upheaval including a Council member's resignation and allegations of interference in the succession process. The headlines also reflect broader concerns about Trump administration actions affecting the region, including federal cuts and decisions affecting D.C. landmarks. Without statehood, D.C. residents have no senators, and their one delegate to the House cannot vote on the House floor.
